gloss: to be captivated by; to be mesmerized; to be unable to look away

definitions.gloss: to be captivated by; to be mesmerized by; to be entranced
definitions.explanation: To be so attracted or impressed by something's beauty, splendor, or remarkable quality that one cannot look away. The passive form suggests being involuntarily drawn in.

examples.japanese: {夕焼|ゆうや}けの{美|うつく}しさに{目|め}を{奪|うば}われた。
examples.english: I was captivated by the beauty of the sunset.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}のドレス{姿|すがた}に{目|め}を{奪|うば}われた。
examples.english: I was mesmerized by her in that dress.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}わず{目|め}を{奪|うば}われるほどの{絶景|ぜっけい}だった。
examples.english: It was such a breathtaking view that I couldn't help but be captivated.

notes:
IDIOM STRUCTURE:
{目|め} (eyes) + を + {奪|うば}われる (to be taken/stolen - passive)

Literally "to have one's eyes stolen" - implies something is so striking that it captures and holds your gaze involuntarily.

GRAMMAR:
〜に{目|め}を{奪|うば}われる - to be captivated by ~
{思|おも}わず{目|め}を{奪|うば}われる - to be involuntarily captivated

NUANCE:
Always positive - used for things of beauty, grandeur, or impressive quality:
- {景色|けしき} (scenery)
- {美|び} (beauty)
- {芸術|げいじゅつ} (art)
- {人|ひと}の{姿|すがた} (someone's appearance)

The passive form emphasizes that the viewer has no control - the beauty compels attention.

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・{見|み}とれる - to be fascinated, to gaze in admiration
・{見入|みい}る - to gaze at intently
・{魅了|みりょう}される - to be charmed/fascinated
・{心|こころ}を{奪|うば}われる - to have one's heart stolen
・{目|め}を{引|ひ}く - to catch the eye (less intense)

REGISTER:
Slightly literary/poetic. Common in descriptive writing and when expressing admiration.
